I want to include an undead faction in my game. At first, they were going to be vampires. So much so, that I included a Vampire Spawn as an enemy in Session 1. However, I am really starting to dislike the idea, and all they know was that the enemy could change into gas while grappled. It was a short fight and no negative levels were distributed.

The setting is homebrew, but encompasses desert badlands (like the midwest of the US) and has a much sandier area to the east (stereotypical egypt). The players are cluesless about the story so far, but there are ten distinct bandit groups operating under one name, and one of the groups is undead, and they live in the sandier, more egyptian area.

I like Libris Mortis' vampire variants, and I considered making them psychic vampires (No negative levels, but they have an aura of wisdom damage). I don't want to dish negative levels out, but I was at a loss for neat ideas. I basically wanted to hybridize them with other undead (mummies, wights, worgs, etc.), but none of their features seem too unique.

So here is what I have: Undead creature Gaseous form SLA Instead of inhabiting a coffin, it inhabits a Ceramic jar with a weird nozzle on top (for gaseous form entrance). Players have encountered jars, but they haven't been too interested in them and they don't know their purpose.

Here is what I want: An undead that is exciting for the veteran players Has a fun mechanic that does not involve level loss (fun for me, at least) A way to procreate,

Hit me with your ideas!
